summary: ACDE #241 确认 glamsterdam-devnet-7 向应用开发者开放（300M gas limit），devnet-8 可能是升级公共测试网前最后一个 devnet，主网前至少还需 3 个月；Hegotá 非 headliner 提案截止 8 月 6 日。svlachakis 提交一组 EIP-8141 规范澄清，涉及签名编码、执行批准范围、存储退款、calldata 下限和收据传输。chunter-cb 提交 ERC-8340，定义 EIP-8130 交易 `metadata` 字段的字节布局。Francesco（fradamt）从 EF 加入 Ethlabs，并表示快速确认已上 Glamsterdam devnet。

items.title: 新 EIP：部分执行 payload 承诺
items.note: （nerolation）提交，据 Ethereal news #31 编号 EIP-8341，作为 EIP-7862 的替代方案，不在执行层处理延迟状态根，同时给 builder 和 prover 更多时间。
items.title_en: New EIP: Partial Execution Payload Commitments
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted; per Ethereal news #31 it is numbered EIP-8341. It is an alternative to EIP-7862 that avoids a delayed state root on the execution layer while still giving builders and provers more time.

items.title: 固定 SECP256K1 签名编码（恢复 id 与 low-s）
items.note: svlachakis 一次提交多项澄清：固定 SECP256K1 签名编码（恢复 id 与 low-s），此前 `validate_signature` 直接传给 `ecrecover`，没有规定 `v` 的编码也不要求 `s` 规范化；说明执行批准会授权之后所有 sender frame，`sender_approved` 是交易级标志而非按 frame 或目标限定；规定 frame 的 EIP-3529 存储退款记账；对 frame 和签名数据应用 EIP-7623 calldata 下限，此前交易 gas 从未取下限；定义 frame 交易收据的 Receipts 消息编码；以及 FRAMEDATALOAD/FRAMEDATACOPY 栈操作数顺序。
items.title_en: pin the SECP256K1 signature encoding (recovery id and low-s)
items.note_en: Svlachakis submitted several clarifications at once: pin the SECP256K1 signature encoding (recovery id and low-s), since `validate_signature` passed signatures straight into `ecrecover` without defining `v` or requiring a canonical `s`; note that execution approval authorizes all subsequent sender frames, because `sender_approved` is a transaction-scoped flag, not scoped to a frame or target; specify EIP-3529 storage refund accounting for frames; apply the EIP-7623 calldata floor to frame and signature data, since the transaction's gas was never floored; define the Receipts message encoding for frame transaction receipts; and the stack operand order for FRAMEDATALOAD/FRAMEDATACOPY.

items.title: 用 MAX_SIGNATURES 限制签名列表长度
items.note: 也被提出：`signatures` 是 frame 交易家族中唯一没有显式上限的变长列表，只受 `tx_gas_limit` 隐式约束，可达上千条。
items.title_en: Bounding the signatures list with MAX_SIGNATURES
items.note_en: Was also proposed: `signatures` is the only variable-length list in the frame transaction family without an explicit bound, limited only implicitly by `tx_gas_limit`, which allows thousands of entries.

items.title: ERC-8340：交易元数据编码
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交，论坛讨论 06:08。EIP-8130 的 AA 交易有可选的不透明 `metadata` 字段，本 ERC 规定它是确定性 CBOR 值（备注、承诺摘要、保留键映射或其数组），键与 ERC-8021 schema 2 兼容，任意值可替换为加盐承诺，实现选择性披露，并给出链下证明包和 ERC-5792 集成。
items.title_en: ERC-8340: Transaction Metadata Encoding
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted, with forum discussion at 06:08. EIP-8130's AA transaction has an optional opaque `metadata` field; this ERC defines it as a deterministic CBOR value (memo, commitment digest, a map of reserved keys, or an array of these), with keys compatible with ERC-8021 schema 2. Any value can be replaced by a salted commitment for selective disclosure, and the ERC specifies an offchain proof package and ERC-5792 integration.

summary_en: ACDE #241 confirmed that glamsterdam-devnet-7 is open to app developers (300M gas limit), that devnet-8 is likely the last devnet before public testnets upgrade, and that mainnet is at least 3 months away; the deadline for non-headliner Hegotá proposals is August 6. svlachakis submitted a set of EIP-8141 spec clarifications covering signature encoding, execution approval scope, storage refunds, the calldata floor and receipt exchange. chunter-cb submitted ERC-8340, which defines the byte layout of the `metadata` field in EIP-8130 transactions. Francesco (fradamt) moved from the EF to Ethlabs and said fast confirmation is already on Glamsterdam devnets.
